name: Path to the World Tree
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
{2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, Sacrifice this enchantment: You gain 2 life and draw two cards. Target opponent loses 2 life. This enchantment deals 2 damage to up to one target creature. You create a 2/2 green Bear creature token.
blocked_sentences: {2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, Sacrifice this enchantment: You gain 2 life and draw two cards. Target opponent loses 2 life. This enchantment deals 2 damage to up to one target creature. You create a 2/2 green Bear creature token.

needs.what: a 2/2 green Bear creature token (e.g. id bear_2_2_g)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Bear token; the nearest 2/2 green tokens (boar_2_2_g, cat_2_2_g, wolf_2_2_g, elemental_2_2_g) have the wrong creature type. The rest of the line (sacrifice cost, gain_life, draw, lose_life on a player target, damage to an optional creature target) and the enters search_library to hand are expressible.
